title: Write custom service policies in Python (Beta)
body: You can now write a custom service policy as a Python function in Unity Catalog. Use it for rules that SQL can't express, such as regular expressions, Python packages, or calls to an external guardrail through a service credential. It's available in select regions. See [Write a custom Python service policy](/aws/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/service-policies/python-policies).
